Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack GenAI Engineer to join in a Hybrid work model. This role blends modern front-end engineering (React) with backend/GenAI engineering (Python) to build enterprise-grade GenAI applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will develop user-centric AI experiences, integrate agentic workflows using Google ADK and MCP, and deliver secure, scalable solutions aligned to Risk and governance expectations.

Experience: 8-9 years
Work Mode: Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-time / Contract
Primary Stack: React, Python, GCP, Google ADK, MCP
Additional Requirement: Working experience of LangChain
Required Technical Skills

Front End

React (advanced): component design, state management, performance optimization, accessibility, and API integration
Strong UI engineering fundamentals: modular design, error handling, and responsive layouts

Backend / Programming

Python (advanced): API development, data handling, async patterns (as needed), testing, packaging, and clean architecture

GenAI / Agentic Frameworks (Core)

Hands-on experience with Google ADK and MCP for agent/tool orchestration and connectors
Working knowledge of LangChain and LangGraph (prompting, tools, orchestration concepts, stateful workflows)

Cloud

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience building and deploying applications in enterprise settings
Familiarity with secure cloud patterns: IAM concepts, secrets management, networking basics, logging/monitoring

Databases / Vector DBs (Any)

Experience with at least one database and a vector store (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Elastic/OpenSearch, etc.)
Understanding of embedding-based retrieval, indexing, and retrieval quality tuning

Required Experience

Must be proficient in ReactJS, Python
Must have production experience with Langchain and Google ADK.
Must have at least 1 production grade GenAI application with these technologies
Must have 6+ years of work experience
Mandatory Competencies
Data AI - GEN AI - Workflow Agentic Frameworks (LangChain / LangGraph)
Data AI - GEN AI - AI Search Index
Data AI - GEN AI - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) / Graph RAG / Agentic AI Systems
Data AI - GEN AI - Advanced GenAI Agentic Framework Concepts
Data AI - GEN AI - Fine-tuning Model Customization / AI Agents Tool Calling
Data AI - GEN AI - Cloud Application Integration Deployment
Data AI - GEN AI - Python
Data AI - GEN AI - Prompt Engineering / Vector Databases
Data AI - GEN AI - Pandas
Data AI - GEN AI - NumPy
Beh - Communication and collaboration
